title: Productive Use of Energy in Uganda's Agriculture: Policy Priorities and Investment Opportunities
summary: Policy brief outlining priority actions for government, donors, and private sector to accelerate productive use of renewable energy in Uganda's agricultural sector.
description: This policy brief analyses the current state of productive use of energy (PUE) in Uganda's agriculture and identifies priority policy actions, institutional changes, and investment opportunities. The brief argues that while significant progress has been made in expanding energy access, the translation of energy access into productive economic use — particularly in agriculture — has been insufficient. Key recommendations include: establishing a dedicated national productive use of energy programme under NREP coordination; introducing import duty exemptions for agri-energy processing equipment; developing national standards for solar agri-energy products; and creating a blended finance facility for agri-energy SMEs. The brief is intended for policymakers, development partners, and private sector actors engaged in the energy and agriculture sectors.
